One Dashboard. Custom Configs. Complete Network Freedom.

VPN Server Hub has evolved into the ultimate network utility and configuration generator for power users. Instead of locking you into a single, fixed connection, we put the control in your hands. Generate, test, monitor, and export custom V2Ray and WireGuard configurations directly from your mobile dashboard.

Whether you need to bypass strict firewalls or deploy high-speed private nodes, VPN Server Hub gives you the tools to build your own internet gateway.

🚀 Generate Free Custom Configs On-Demand
Need high-speed, secure tunnels? Generate fresh V2Ray links and WireGuard configuration files instantly in the app.
• 25 GB Free Quota Upfront: Start generating custom servers immediately with a generous 25 GB complimentary bandwidth pool.
• Watch Ads, Earn Coins: Out of quota? Watch short rewarded ads to instantly reload your wallet (1 Coin = 1 GB). Customize your server's bandwidth limit exactly how you need it.
• Export & Share Anywhere: Generate configuration text, copy V2Ray subscription links, or share files instantly to use on any compatible device or client.

🛠️ Advanced Diagnostics & Monitoring
• Live Bandwidth Tracking: Keep a close eye on your usage. Monitor your active server bandwidth to manage your 24-hour node lifecycles effectively.
• Server Details at a Glance: Instantly view your node’s expiration time, location, port, and connection protocol directly from the expandable server card.

🌍 Ultimate Protocol Support
Manage and generate configs across the world's most robust tunneling protocols. We fully integrate:
• WireGuard®: The industry gold standard for lightweight, blazing-fast encryption.
• V2Ray (VMess / VLESS / Trojan / Shadowsocks): Advanced obfuscation and routing to bypass strict local network firewalls and deep packet inspection.
• Outline VPN: Simplified, powerful access based on Shadowsocks.
• IKEv2 & OpenVPN: Perfect for stable mobile switching and custom enterprise configurations.

🎯 Built for DIY Power Users
• Custom Subscription Links: Easily import and manage your external V2Ray subscription URLs alongside your internally generated configs.
• Battery & Performance Optimized: A clean, intuitive dashboard that makes managing complex networking protocols simple and resource-efficient.

🛡️ Strict No-Activity-Logs Policy
Your privacy is our absolute priority. VPN Server Hub is a utility engine, not a tracking network. We never track, store, or share your browsing history, destination websites, data content, or DNS queries. What you do online is your business alone.

Take control of your network routing. Download VPN Server Hub today, earn your free bandwidth, and deploy your custom secure configs in seconds!

Contact Us:
Need help or have questions? Reach out to our support team directly at support@vpnserverhub.com or visit us at app.vpnserverhub.com.
